# Write the report

Create `reports/my-study-report.qmd` using the synthetic report structure. Replace all fictional content with your question, source, counts, verification values, results and limitations. Paths from `reports/` to your figures begin `../results/my-study/figures/`.

```bash
quarto render reports/my-study-report.qmd --to html
```

Include Q–Q only if it was appropriate and generated. Open the HTML and check every image, numerical claim and allele label. Keep learner reports out of Git; the provided `.gitignore` ignores `reports/`.

**Ready to share:** another reader can trace the results to the inputs and methods, and can identify which conclusions need replication, LD information or further analysis.
